rationale: VERSION 2.0.1 -> 3.0.0: replaced nine clamped, alias, dead-texture, and degenerate controls with exact scene_profile and span_regime axes.; Rebuilt defaults around all five complete public canvas/orientation/length profiles with a 40% exact linked prior and a bounded 60% varied clear-span regime.; Replaced sequential retry placement with constructive noncrossing layout selection, so later endpoints cannot poison earlier spans and every requested scene is complete.; Added strict ARC parsing, returned-grid extraction, observable axes, a broad input-pure row-then-column Python oracle, difficulty-scaled span mass, and RULE_HASH.; Added focused mutation/order tests, two disjoint 60,000-draw censuses, 60 negative recombinations, 497 live-Racket cases, and trainer-facing visual evidence.
summary: For each row independently, fill the inclusive span of any color appearing exactly twice on that row when the original span contains only zero and that color. Then do the same for each column, still testing the original input and painting over the row-filled result; therefore a valid column span wins at a crossing.
